name: Federal Register API
agency: Office of the Federal Register / GPO

endpoints.description: Search Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, notices)
Single document by FR document number

limits.notes: No key, no published hard limit. Use per_page (max 1000) and page; be considerate on bulk crawls.

llmDocs.summary: The daily journal of the US federal government: presidential documents, final/proposed rules, and agency notices. Full text and metadata, searchable since 1994.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Use conditions[...] filters: conditions[term], conditions[agencies][], conditions[type][] (RULE, PRORULE, NOTICE, PRESDOCU), conditions[publication_date][gte]. Choose returned fields with fields[]. Use per_page up to 1000.
gotchas: Agency filters use agency slugs (e.g. 'environmental-protection-agency'), not free text.
Bracketed array params (conditions[type][]) must be URL-encoded properly.
Full document body text is fetched separately via the raw_text_url / body_html_url in the document response.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government records. Free to redistribute.
